<!-- All of the content are examples. make sure to replace them when writing out a bug.-->

**What is the bug?**
Describe the bug.
e.g. The game glitches out on level 4-1 after clicking Lakitu.


**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behaviour, e.g.
1. Go to level 4-1
2. Click on Lakitu

**Expected behaviour**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.
e.g. I expected the level to run normally.

**Screenshots**
<!-- If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem. -->

**Device**
Describe your device details here:
 - Device: [e.g. iPhone6]
 - OS: [e.g. iOS 26.0]
 - Browser [e.g. chrome, safari]
 - Version [e.g. 22]

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
